text: Implemented production Sampled[S,A,Sem,R] ownership; reference-identity equals/hashCode for SampleSpace and Sampled; named live/persistent/exact/approximate/value/storage relations; reusable SamplingAlignment identity/reverse/composition; zero-copy rebind; same-owner and aligned zip; validated NumericTolerance with allClose/allCloseAligned; and explicit unit/storage policies. Relation matrix covers live/restored owners, distinct keys with exact geometry, approximate geometry, unit/convention/coordinate mismatches, metadata independence, NaN/signed zero/infinity, O(1) 4D hashing, compile-negative unrelated zip, alignment laws, rebind round trip, and alignment reuse across full pointwise zips. Full non-locus court passed 244 JVM/Scala.js test executions; optimized core Scala.js link passed. JVM ranked Sampled and direct Ravel each allocated 40 B over 22,440 matched reads. One earlier combined-run timing sample was noisy; the isolated rerun and subsequent full court passed without changing the 3x guard.
